notes.title: Devlog #6: The Demo vs The Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Explorers, Automators, and Spark-Petters

Now that there’s we're counting the days before our Early Access release (April 24th!!), let’s talk a bit about what has changed between the demo and the Early Access and also talk a little bit about the roadmap for the future! You know that we’re adding more content, but we’ve changed a lot more since the demo, and we want you to be updated so you know what to expect. 

Something important to note is that [b]we will be taking down the demo when we release[/b]! 

[h3]Spark Traffic[/h3]

Something really big and important is that [b]we’ve changed how Sparks interact with buildings[/b]. Instead of being able to interact with buildings on their left- and right-hand side, we’ve changed it so that [b]Sparks can now only interact with the right hand side of the path[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/c20e285dcec3c1da18b19ca3649871eb8bd98fc8.png[/img]

We’ve seen some of our players already talk about how to build The Perfect Base and this will change things a lot. The Spark Traffic system is not set in stone! We’ll continue balancing and figuring out what kind of late game builds we want to encourage and discourage. 

With this change and other tools that you haven’t seen yet, we’re sure that it’ll change how you think about building. We can’t wait to see what you all come up with!

[h3]Send Feedback Directly From Game[/h3]

Previously, you could send us feedback via our Discord, the steam forums, or even by email at Feedback@massiveminiteam.com. We’ve added a new way, and now you can now [b]send us feedback and bugs directly from the game[/b]! You can open it via the in-game menu, or directly by pressing F8.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/bf9644d9510e371f5742fc67ff9121202c1e408e.png[/img]

[h3]The Tutorial[/h3]

[b]We’ve ripped out a lot of the tutorial and streamlined it[/b]. We want to try out something a little less intrusive than our previous tutorial setup, so that means [b]fewer tutorial quests[/b] and in general, leading you towards the [b]gameplay glossary[/b]. 

[h3]World Generation[/h3]

We’ve been squashing world generation bugs and making it better. We’ve [b]changed how waypoints are placed[/b] so it should be always useful and there isn’t two that are too close to each other, and there’s [b]more ancient bases[/b] and now they spawn in a grid! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/5dd074bee08e9490797f0860b7dcccadc519a96b.png[/img]

It might sound like a small change, but this will make a difference on how you look at the map and how you build your bases! The aim is to create something that you can replay a lot without giving you bad seeds, and still have lots of very interesting challenges each time you start a new save.

[h3]The Spark Keys[/h3]

[b]The Spark Keys are out[/b]! So it was always a very temporary thing. We realized as we were finalizing the demo that the game wasn’t really telling you just how much future content we were thinking of having in the final game, or how we were planning to pace the game. That’s why we very quickly implemented the Spark Keys! We have a lot of content in mind and we wanted you to know that what you’ve seen in the demo is only a small amount of the game.

So now, they’ve been [b]replaced with a new feature, Monument Quests[/b]! The monument now handles a lot of things related to the player and related to the shrines. So for example, instead of unlocking the Spark shrines individually, you’ll be unlocking them in the Monument. With the villager quests and the monument quests, we hope to create a more [b]open ended progression[/b] that’s a lot of fun to go through and explore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/5a4b664ccd2cd416dd44bbd8526b53fe2174f76c.png[/img]

[h3]Build Mode[/h3]

Instead of opening the build menu every single time, we’ve [b]streamlined the build mode[/b] so that it’s much nicer to build the same type of building over and over. Basically, you now have a [b]history of the 5 previously built buildings[/b] that you can quick access, and you [b]open that history first before you open the buildings menu[/b]. It's not perfect, but it's better and we'll continue working on the UX to make sure it's as good as it can be.

The current changes are a bit hard to imagine via text, but we feel like [b]it’s a lot smoother now to build things repeatedly[/b]! You’ll thank us when you explore the mountains.

[h3]Mouse & Keyboard Inventory Shortcuts[/h3]

We heard that some of you find the mouse & keyboard inventory shortcuts annoying, so we went back to the drawing board. To be honest, designing the controls for this game has been pretty difficult. As a genre mix, we have different conventions pushing and pulling us towards different directions. It’s very clear to see which genre people like when they give us feedback! 

[b]We’ve made inventory management easier by adding two more shortcuts and overhauling the design[/b]. We’ve also made the shortcuts a bit more obvious, so you can get used to it a little faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/ff39f79096d3145b4c2e315b8745bd33b0aed6c2.png[/img]

[h3]Minimap, Map Marker & Controls[/h3]

You asked for a minimap and [b]we now have a minimap[/b]! We had a lot of internal discussions about it because we wanted navigating and exploring the world to be part of the game, but we ended up seeing that it was more annoying than we wanted it to be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/7510bcccb0d26f73de1f212bc7dd9bc0169c003a.png[/img]

We also added a lot of quality of life features to the map itself. We changed the map controls to some player feedback and have made the map marker much better. [b]You can now mark important landmarks on the map[/b]!

[h3]Single Spark Callback[/h3]

The callback has gotten a round of improvement so [b]it’s easier to call back a single Spark[/b]. Maybe you accidentally threw a Crafty on a path when you didn’t mean to. Or you just want to micromanage combat more and call back a particular Stumpy before the Beelephant attacks it? Well, either way, it’s now much easier and smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/f8ed0d34e42e46fb33f540587c7e21e7fa091e4f.png[/img]

[h3]Better Button Remapping[/h3]

[b]We’ve worked on the button remapping and have made more buttons available[/b] so you can play your own way. As we said before, juggling the genre mix of controls is not easy, so this way, you can set the controls to how you like it! This feature is definitely something that only gets better by player feedback, so if you have them, please reach out to us!

[h3]More Languages[/h3]

We already mentioned this, but yes, [b]Oddsparks is being translated[/b]! Our Early Access release will have [b]English, German, French, and Japanese[/b]. We’ll have all of our gameplay texts (e.g. Building and Item names, UI, quest instructions, tutorials) and our quest descriptions texts ready but likely [b]not all of the dialogues will be completed at release[/b].

That means that [b]when you are playing in a language other than English, some quests will only have its description texts and no dialogue[/b]. We’ve tried to make sure that these are quests later in the game, so [b]you will have a smooth early game experience, whichever language you’re playing in[/b].

If you want to see the English dialogues in places where there isn’t a translation, there will be an option made available in the settings menu! 

[h3]And even more![/h3]

This list is getting too long! We’ve also worked on [b]balancing and quest progression[/b] and have done some big changes from the the demo. We’ve added [b]in-game achievements[/b] (no steam achievements until we’re 100% sure that the achievements are staying how they are) and a lot [b]more customization options[/b], that are unlocked by the in-game achievements! A [b]multiplayer room code system for crossplay[/b] between Steam and Epic. We now have [b]UI Scaling[/b]!

Okay, that’s enough. Let’s talk about the future.

[h2]The Early Access Plan[/h2]

We're sorting out our roadmap and will reveal to you very soon. We want to keep things a bit more secret for now - after all, you have the whole Woodlands and Mountains to explore first! [b]We’re still planning to update you at least once a month with a devlog[/b] so you know what’s happening with the development. 

In general, we're planning for lots of room to not just build what we want but to listen to feedback and work with the community to make the game the best it can be. We have a big list of features you've already requested, we're already sorting them by priority and figuring out where they fit into our production plan. 

Of course, you can also get more frequent updates by joining us at [url=https://discord.com/invite/45SzrRMUhy]our Discord[/url]!

We’re all looking forward to you finally joining us on this Oddsparks journey properly with the Early Access release. We can’t wait to see your sprawling bases, your cool outfits, your surprise and joy at what the game holds. 

So please tell your friends about us and we’ll see you for the Early Access Release on April 24th!

notes.title: Devlog #4: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Quartermasters, Merchants and Divine Researchers,

It's Steam Next Fest and our demo is here! Well, it's been out for a while now and it's wonderful to see everyone's reactions to our game. Of course, there's still a lot of things to make but I hope you can see the vision we have for the game and will support us as we go through the Early Access journey together!

Normally for these Devlogs, we give people a few options for the next topic and you can vote on [url=https://discord.com/invite/45SzrRMUhy]our Discord [/url]but today, we wanted to talk about our Early Access. What we're planning, how we want to do things. You might have seen some information in the other Steam news posts, but let's take our time properly to chat.

[h2]Early Access Release[/h2]
So you should have seen that we have a date, we're going into Early Access on the [b]24th of April 2024[/b]! You'll be able to buy our game at a reduced price (compared to when we have our v1.0) and play through two biomes! 

You can unlock the rest of The Woodlands and get the Carry and the Loamy Spark, and explore our new biome, The Mountains and play with the new mountain Sparks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/b30cce442ce34b61eba3a63314d53fea259da0cc.png[/img]
[i]A little glimpse at three new friends to look forward to![/i]

[h3]Continuing Demo Save Games[/h3]
[u]You will not be able to continue the saves you've started in the demo[/u]. 

The game has been changed too much and a lot of things have been added. Unfortunately, this will happen a few times during Early Access - when we change the world generation rules, it will break every save. Of course, we don't want to keep ruining everyone's saves, so we'll be careful to only break saves when necessary.

To alleviate this issue, we'll release updates in beta branches to make sure that any big updates that will require you to start afresh is as good as possible. Starting from Early Access, we'll also keep old branches so that if there was something you wanted to complete, you'll be able to continue your save in an old branch! You won't see any of the new stuff, but we'd like to let you play at your own pace. 

You will also be able to skip some of the beginning tutorialization. When you skip the tutorial, you'll start where you can almost immediately leave the village and go straight to the Stumpy Spark Shrine to get your first Spark. We'll also tell you in the updates if we end up changing the beginning and whether we're recommending you to start the new save with the tutorial on, or if you can just dive in. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/397196f4440673934a180ecbac77d1d1d48580fa.png[/img][i]When you just want to go straight to that first Spark.[/i]

[h3]The Mountains[/h3]
We're currently finishing up our second biome: The Mountains! We're still doing some work on the gameplay and progression at the moment and finalizing how we spread out the fun toys that we're going to give you. 

Now that you've played for a few hours, we want to ramp things up! You'll have to use ladders, ramps, ziplines and elevators to get yourself, your Sparks and your items up and down elevation levels. You'll have to explore a biome full of aggressive enemies to search for shrines and resources - even simple enemies are a lot harder to deal with when they're in combination with each other. 

You'll even find a way to finally create an infinite source of Aether Shards! But making it run perfectly is going to be a little tricky. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489382/e525e3fb16bd603f8c50d260e2804eadd7ec9561.png[/img][i]What an unusual looking building! What does this one do?[/i]

[h2]Future Content & 1.0 Release Plans[/h2]
We're not quite ready to reveal our living roadmap just yet. Our initial plans are to do Early Access for one year, but of course, we want the game to be the best it can be. We'd love to support the game for as long as it needs before we give it the version number 1.0.

We'll have more biomes, more Sparks and more logistical challenges and tools. Including some really fun stuff that we want to already tell you about, but will restrain ourselves for now. You've already got the Early Access release to be excited for! 

For now, we hope you enjoy our demo, tell your friends about us, and tell us your feedback and thoughts over at the Steam Discussions, [url=https://discord.com/invite/45SzrRMUhy]our Discord[/url], or even email us at feedback@massiveminiteam.com.

notes.title: Oddsparks Patch Notes (Demo; v0.1.S15223)
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone helping us test these changes in the beta branch.
These changes are now live for everyone!

[h2]Changelog (Demo; v0.1.S15223)[/h2]
[h3]Important Changes:[/h3]
[list][*] [b][i]Remappable Keybindings[/i]: Added rebindable movement and camera keys.[/b]
We prioritised adding rebindable movement and camera keys into the feature. You can now rebind movement control from WASD and camera control from Arrow Keys. The feature is still in Beta and better keybinding UX will come later. 
[*] [b][i]Default KBM Controls[/i]: Moved Radial Menu off Shift key to [strike]Alt[/strike] +.[/b]
We didn't realise just how used everyone was to pressing Shift! Since accidentally opening the radial menu was a very destructive mistake to the moment to moment flow, we've moved it to [strike]Alt[/strike]. However, we are keeping the rest of the default keybindings the way they are for now, until we get more feedback and data.
Note: This has now been changed to + since Alt was also causing problems.
[*] [b][i]Pinned Quest UI[/i]: Added "Return to Questgiver" reminder.[/b]
We noticed players not realising that they were supposed to hand over quests, partially due to players being used to tutorial quests auto-completing. We have added a reminder that only appears when you have finished all the steps that you should return to the quest giver. 
[*] [b][i]Movement Speed[/i]: Minor bump to standard walk speed, no change to path running speed.[/b]
[u]This may cause some more pop-in of the environment[/u], but unfortunately, that's the tradeoff. Hopefully it should make walking not feel punishing, while making it still feel rewarding to build paths for your own personal use.
[*] [b][i]Online Multiplayer[/i]: Stability fixes for 3-4 players.[/b]
Multiplayer sessions with 3-4 players should be a lot more stable than it was previously. We still have some issues, but playing with 3-4 players shouldn't be less stable than 2 players anymore. 
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some client crashes.
[*] Fixed multiplayer saves suddenly having millions of play hours counted (for hosts).
[*] Removed traces of secret project name before Oddsparks was called Oddsparks. 
[/list]
[h3]Additional info:[/h3]
[list]
[*] if you changed your keybindings, double check them after the update
[/list]

If you have any feedback, notice any bugs or had any crashes, you can let us know via the usual methods. Hit us up on [url=https://discord.gg/45SzrRMUhy]our Discord[/url]. tell us on our Steam Discussions forum, or you can email us at [url=mailto: feedback@massiveminiteam.com]feedback@massiveminiteam.com[/url].
